_provenance: CONTROLLED TEST EXAMPLES — NOT extracted from any real insurer document. Every sentence below was hand-authored for this evaluation, using realistic Austrian insurance phrasing patterns and terminology (matching the controlled vocabulary in app/nlp/extractor.py), to exercise each of the 10 ClauseType classes evenly. This dataset exists because the project has no genuinely-sourced real IPID/AVB documents to evaluate against (see docs/DATA_SOURCES.md) — using it is the only honest way to produce real, non-fabricated precision/recall/F1 numbers, as opposed to either skipping evaluation entirely or inventing metrics. See docs/NLP_EVALUATION.md.
author: Claude (this session), for backend/scripts/evaluate_nlp.py
